topic: editing a prettierignored vendored file requires removing its entry D-0006
lesson: Per decision/deferral D-0006 (plans/deferrals.md), before a task edits any .prettierignore-listed vendored file (e.g. backend/src/db/migrate.ts) it MUST, in the SAME change, run prettier on that file AND remove its line from .prettierignore. This is an authorized, decision-mandated edit - .prettierignore is a mechanically-required in-scope file for such an edit, NOT a scope violation; do not raise a scope signal for it (stage-done amend-scope records it).
